decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog commit title [ev-9e39578d4d4b]. It names the subject loosely (the ApplicationSet PullRequest and SCM generators talking to GitHub without tokenRef) and the symptom (HTTP 401). It does not say what the fixed behaviour is (for example, falling back to unauthenticated requests), and it does not say which earlier versions had the 401 bug. This is a cherry-pick (#22737) into the 3.0 release line, so the bug may have been a regression in a 3.0 pre-release rather than something 2.x users hit, which leaves applicability and consequence undecidable. The linked PR or issue text is needed to settle the subject's exact configuration path, which source versions are exposed, and what changes for operators after upgrading.
